name: 20-20-20 Rule
steps: Look away from your screen and find an object at least 20 feet away.
Focus on that distant object for 20 seconds.
Blink several times to re-moisten your eyes.
Return your gaze to the screen.

name: Eye Circles
steps: Close your eyes gently and relax your face.
Slowly roll your eyes in a clockwise circle 5 times.
Reverse direction and roll counterclockwise 5 times.
Open your eyes and blink rapidly for a few seconds.

name: Neck Rolls
steps: Sit up straight and drop your chin toward your chest.
Slowly roll your head to the right, bringing your ear toward your shoulder.
Continue the circle by tilting your head back gently.
Roll to the left side and back to center. Repeat 3 times each direction.

name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
steps: Extend your right arm straight out with the palm facing up.
Use your left hand to gently pull the fingers of your right hand downward.
Hold for 15 seconds, feeling the stretch along the inner forearm.
Switch to the left arm and repeat.

name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
steps: Extend your right arm straight out with the palm facing down.
Use your left hand to gently press the back of your right hand downward.
Hold for 15 seconds, feeling the stretch along the outer forearm.
Switch to the left arm and repeat.

name: Shoulder Shrugs
steps: Sit or stand with your arms relaxed at your sides.
Raise both shoulders up toward your ears as high as you can.
Hold at the top for 3 seconds, squeezing tightly.
Drop your shoulders back down and relax. Repeat 8 times.

name: Seated Spinal Twist
steps: Sit up tall with both feet flat on the floor.
Place your right hand on the outside of your left knee.
Gently twist your torso to the left, looking over your left shoulder.
Hold for 15 seconds, then return to center.
Repeat on the other side.

name: Desk Push-Ups
steps: Place your hands shoulder-width apart on the edge of your desk.
Step your feet back until your body forms a straight line at an angle.
Lower your chest toward the desk by bending your elbows.
Push back up to the starting position. Repeat 10 times.

name: Chin Tucks
steps: Sit up straight and look directly ahead.
Gently draw your chin straight back, creating a double chin.
Hold for 5 seconds, feeling the stretch at the base of your skull.
Release and repeat 8 times.

name: Seated Leg Extensions
steps: Sit up straight with your feet flat on the floor.
Extend your right leg out straight until it is parallel with the floor.
Hold for 5 seconds, squeezing your quadricep.
Lower slowly and repeat with the left leg. Do 8 reps per side.

name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
steps: Stand and place your right heel on a low surface like a stool or chair.
Keep your right leg straight and flex your foot so your toes point up.
Hinge forward at your hips with a flat back until you feel a stretch behind your thigh.
Hold for 30 seconds, breathing deeply.
Switch legs and repeat. Do 2 rounds per side.

name: Wall Chest Stretch
steps: Stand in a doorway or next to a wall.
Place your right forearm vertically against the wall with your elbow at shoulder height.
Step your right foot forward and gently lean through the doorway until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Hold for 30 seconds, then switch sides.
Repeat 2 times per side.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch
steps: Step your right foot forward into a lunge position.
Lower your left knee to the ground (use a folded towel for padding if needed).
Keep your torso upright and gently push your hips forward.
Hold for 30 seconds, feeling the stretch in the front of your left hip.
Switch sides and repeat. Do 2 rounds per side.

name: Calf Raises
steps: Stand behind your chair and lightly hold the back for balance.
Rise up onto the balls of both feet, lifting your heels as high as possible.
Hold at the top for 2 seconds.
Lower back down slowly. Repeat for 3 sets of 15 reps.

name: Standing Forward Fold
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Exhale and hinge forward at your hips, letting your arms and head hang heavy.
Bend your knees slightly if you feel tightness behind your legs.
Hold for 30 seconds, gently swaying side to side.
Slowly roll back up to standing one vertebra at a time.

name: Cat-Cow Stretch
steps: Stand with your hands on your knees, or get on all fours if space allows.
Inhale and arch your back, lifting your chest and tailbone upward (cow).
Exhale and round your spine, tucking your chin and tailbone under (cat).
Flow between these two positions slowly for 1 minute.
Rest in a neutral spine position when finished.

name: Full Body Shake-Out
steps: Stand up and begin shaking your hands loosely at your sides.
Gradually add movement by shaking your arms, then your shoulders.
Shake each leg one at a time, then bounce lightly on both feet.
Let the shaking travel through your whole body for 2 minutes.
Slow down gradually and take 3 deep breaths to finish.

name: Walking in Place
steps: Stand up tall next to your desk with your arms at your sides.
Begin marching in place, lifting your knees to hip height if comfortable.
Swing your arms naturally with each step.
Continue for 2-3 minutes at a brisk pace.
Slow your pace for the last 30 seconds and take deep breaths.

name: Stationary Lunges
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, hands on your hips.
Step your right foot forward and lower your body until both knees form 90-degree angles.
Push through your right heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs for 10 reps per side, doing 2 sets.
Rest for 15 seconds between sets.

name: Wall Squat Hold
steps: Stand with your back flat against a wall and feet shoulder-width apart.
Slide down the wall until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees directly above your ankles and your back pressed into the wall.
Hold for 30-60 seconds, breathing steadily.
Slide back up to rest and repeat 3 times.
